title: My Family and Relatives
introduction: Describe family members and familiar relationships.
definition: Describe family members and familiar relationships.
rules: Say each word aloud. Look for examples in everyday life.
Practise the sentences with a partner.

vocabulary.description: A mother, father or other person in a parental role.
A young person or someone's son or daughter.
A male child in relation to a parent.
A female child in relation to a parent.
A parent's brother or a parent's sibling's husband.
A parent's sister or a parent's sibling's wife.
A child of a parent's sibling.

examples.question: Read and say this sentence.
steps: My sister is younger than me.
examples.answer: My sister is younger than me.

exercises.question: Your mother's brother is your ___.
exercises.solution: A parent's brother is your uncle.

exercises.question: Your father's sister is your ___.
exercises.solution: A parent's sister is your aunt.

exercises.question: Your aunt's child is your ___.
exercises.solution: The child of your aunt or uncle is your cousin.

exercises.question: Brothers and sisters are called ___.
exercises.solution: Siblings is the collective term for brothers and sisters.

exercises.question: A female child in relation to her parent is a ___.
exercises.solution: A daughter is a female child in relation to her parent.

exercises.question: A male child in relation to his parent is a ___.
exercises.solution: A son is a male child in relation to his parent.

exercises.question: Your parent's parents are your ___.
exercises.solution: Grandparents are the parents of your parents.

exercises.question: The plural of child is ___.
exercises.solution: Child has an irregular plural; do not add s.

exercises.question: A person related to you is a ___.
exercises.solution: A relative is someone connected to you through family.

exercises.question: Someone who has lived longer than you is ___.
exercises.solution: Older compares the ages of two people and describes the one who has lived longer.

summary: Describe family members and familiar relationships.
